lab.task: Train a tiny weather emulator on the WeatherBench2 ERA5 5.625° Zarr (Z500 + T850, 6-h steps, ~1979–2015 train / 2018–2019 test): small U-Net or your W6 ViT (~1–3M params) predicting residual (Δstate) targets, with per-variable-per-level normalization and static input channels (orography, land–sea mask). Write the lat-weighted MSE loss yourself and test it against analytic values (agent writes the test). Evaluate lat-weighted RMSE and ACC vs persistence and climatology baselines at 1–5-day leads via autoregressive rollout; plot the zonal power spectrum at day 1 vs day 5 to see blurring.
lab.task_ko: WeatherBench2 ERA5 5.625° Zarr(Z500 + T850, 6-h step, train ~1979–2015 / test 2018–2019)로 tiny weather emulator 학습: 작은 U-Net 또는 W6 ViT(~1–3M params)로 residual(Δstate) target 예측, per-variable-per-level normalization과 static 입력 채널(orography, land–sea mask) 사용. lat-weighted MSE loss를 직접 작성하고 해석값 대비 테스트(테스트는 에이전트가 작성). autoregressive rollout으로 1–5일 lead에서 persistence·climatology baseline 대비 lat-weighted RMSE와 ACC 평가 · day 1 vs day 5의 zonal power spectrum을 그려 blurring 확인
lab.deliverable: Note 11 — WB2-style scorecard table (model vs persistence vs climatology), ACC-vs-lead-time plot, spectra figure, rollout animation GIF. This is the weather-direction capstone seed; provisional W8 weather proposals hit their revision gate after this week.
lab.deliverable_ko: Note 11 — WB2 스타일 scorecard 표(model vs persistence vs climatology), ACC vs lead time 플롯, spectra 그림, rollout 애니메이션 GIF · 이것이 weather 방향 capstone의 씨앗 · W8의 잠정 weather 제안은 이번 주 이후 수정 게이트 통과

questions: Derive why unweighted MSE on a lat-lon grid over-weights the poles, and by how much at 60°N.
GraphCast beats HRES on RMSE partly by blurring — how would CRPS-trained GenCast change that comparison, and what does the double-penalty argument say?
Is an ERA5 emulator forecasting the atmosphere or forecasting ECMWF's data assimilation system? Defend both readings.

weeks.title: Scaling the Pipeline: Training Engineering, Fine-Tuning, and Release
weeks.goal: Every remaining capstone skill: efficient training at your compute ceiling, PEFT fine-tuning, ablation design, and a real HF Hub release — after this week you have 100% of the capstone skill set.
weeks.title_ko: 파이프라인 확장: Training 엔지니어링, Fine-Tuning, 릴리스
weeks.goal_ko: capstone에 필요한 나머지 기술 전부 — compute 한도 내 효율적 학습, PEFT fine-tuning, ablation 설계, 실제 HF Hub 릴리스 — 를 익혀 이번 주로 capstone 기술 세트를 100% 갖춥니다.

concept.topic: Training engineering: bf16/AMP recap, gradient accumulation, activation/gradient checkpointing (memory math from W2 revisited), DDP concepts (all-reduce, effective batch size, LR scaling) and when FSDP matters; streaming dataloaders (WebDataset/streaming Zarr) so GPUs never starve.
concept.topic_ko: training 엔지니어링: bf16/AMP 복습, gradient accumulation, activation/gradient checkpointing(W2의 메모리 계산 재방문), DDP 개념(all-reduce, effective batch size, LR scaling)과 FSDP가 중요해지는 시점 · GPU가 굶지 않게 하는 streaming dataloader(WebDataset/streaming Zarr)

concept.topic: Fine-tuning spectrum: linear probe → decoder-only → LoRA/PEFT (derive the low-rank update, rank/alpha choices) → full FT; decoder heads for dense EO tasks (UperNet-style, TerraTorch conventions) and forecast heads for weather.
concept.topic_ko: fine-tuning 스펙트럼: linear probe → decoder-only → LoRA/PEFT(low-rank update 유도, rank/alpha 선택) → full FT · dense EO task용 decoder head(UperNet 스타일, TerraTorch 관례)와 weather용 forecast head

concept.topic: Evaluation and ablation design for the capstone: minimum honest set = {random-init control, supervised baseline (your W4 U-Net or persistence/climatology), frozen probe, fine-tuned}, one ablation axis (masking ratio, data volume, or model size), seeds and error bars.
concept.topic_ko: capstone을 위한 평가·ablation 설계: 최소한의 정직한 세트 = {random-init control, supervised baseline(W4 U-Net 또는 persistence/climatology), frozen probe, fine-tuned}, ablation 축 1개(masking ratio, 데이터 양, 또는 모델 크기), seed와 error bar

concept.topic: Significance testing for forecast and benchmark comparisons: paired block bootstrap over time (and space), why naive per-sample tests lie under autocorrelation, error bars for scorecard tables.
concept.topic_ko: 예보·벤치마크 비교를 위한 유의성 검정: 시간(그리고 공간)에 대한 paired block bootstrap, autocorrelation 아래에서 naive per-sample 검정이 거짓말하는 이유, scorecard 표의 error bar

concept.topic: Release engineering: HF Hub mechanics (weights, config, README.md model card), semantic versioning, licenses for models and data (Copernicus, NASA open-data terms), W&B reports as the lab notebook of record.
concept.topic_ko: 릴리스 엔지니어링: HF Hub 메커니즘(weights, config, README.md model card), semantic versioning, 모델·데이터 라이선스(Copernicus, NASA 공개 데이터 약관), 공식 lab notebook으로서의 W&B report
